title: Judge Orders Trump Officials to Divulge Names of Those Who Set Up $1.8 Billion Fund
summary: The plan to create a fund that could have funneled taxpayer money to the president’s allies drew repeated scrutiny, including a rare rebuke from Senate Republicans.
